narrative.overview:
Pasazhgard reads like a ledger kept by someone who knows the pasaj: slate ink on a cool grey ground, white rows of facts, and every price written down with where it came from and how old it is. The look is Torob's own, carried from the online catalogue into in-person shopping, so a judge or a Torob user recognises it at once. Expression lives in exactness, not ornament: the right word for an unknown, the age of a price, the floor and unit.

The density is mobile and calm. At 360 px a screen holds a sticky filter chip bar, a stack of white cards 8 px apart, and one docked action. There is no dark theme, no gradient, no shadow on content, and no display type: the largest text is 16 px. Colour is rationed. Red marks the one buy or commit action per screen, blue marks talking to a seller or going there, and green and red only report open, closed and confirmed.
keyCharacteristics: Torob's palette and type, light theme only, right-to-left Persian.
Flat white cards on a grey ground; the colour step is the edge.
Three type sizes (12, 14, 16) at two weights (400, 700).
One filled action per result, one red action per screen.
Every fact has a labelled slot; missing values read "نامشخص", never blank.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Torob Red appears on at most one control per screen. If a second action wants red, it is blue, outline or ghost.

rules.name: The Talk-Is-Blue Rule
rules.body: Any action that contacts a seller or leads to a shop is Inquiry Blue. Blue never means "buy".

rules.name: The Muted-On-White Rule
rules.body: Muted ink sits only on white surfaces. Text on the grey ground is ink. Placeholders in the grey search field are the one exception, as on Torob.

rules.name: The Sixteen Ceiling Rule
rules.body: No text is larger than 16 px. A screen that wants a bigger headline wants a clearer slot instead.

rules.name: The Tabular Digits Rule
rules.body: Every number uses `tabular-nums` and goes through `faDigits`: Persian digits with U+066B as the thousands separator ("۳٫۳۴۰٫۰۰۰ تومان").

rules.name: The Paper-On-Grey Rule
rules.body: Cards are white rectangles on grey: no shadow, no ring, no outline. If a card needs separating from another card, the 8 px gap does it.

dos: **Do** give each result exactly one filled action and keep Torob Red to one control per screen.
**Do** write a missing value as "نامشخص" in muted ink, in its labelled slot ("قیمت: نامشخص", "ساعت کاری: نامشخص").
**Do** label price age "آخرین تغییر قیمت" and add "، قدیمی" in notice ink past 30 days.
**Do** colour the open state with the 8 px green dot and keep the words in ink.
**Do** check every new block at 360 px with no sideways page scroll.
donts: **Don't** add a shadow, ring or border to a content card.
**Don't** set text above 16 px or use weights other than 400 and 700.
**Don't** use Open Green as a text colour or Torob Red for anything that isn't the screen's commit action.
**Don't** colour reason badges or show more than one per result.
**Don't** write "به‌روز شده" for a price, or "موجود است" before a seller confirmed it.
**Don't** use Torob's gradient buttons; the flat fill is the gradient's end colour.
